nom: LUSH Ocean Salt Face And Body Scrub

avis.texte: My family loves using the lush Ocean salt face and body scrub! It smells amazing and it makes your skin feel so refreshed. It's become a staple in our household. It is a little pricey but it lasts a long time, so it's worth the occasional treat.
Was hoping it would be similar or comparable to "Happy Skin" but it doesn't exfoliate much and irritates my skin. I'll have to return it.

I've used Lush's original sea salt forever (since 2012). I finally cracked the one that I bought from Ulta open because I ran out of my old stuff and I was like the consistency is odd. Whatever I thought. Then I put it on my face and it did not have the usual refreshing sent. It was pretty similar to Play-Doh. I found myself, wondering if it had gone bad. According to the dates, it's totally fine, but then I realize on the packaging. This is the self preserving one. I had never used this version before and wasn't expecting it so I'm not sure if this is how it usually is? That's my bad I guess since I didn't see it in the fine print and I bought this over 30 days ago. I'll keep using it and hopefully it'll still have the results that the original has.
Ive used this once a week for about a month and I love the way it exfoliates and brightens my skin! It smells like a sweet cereal, and I love using this.
